shots.subject: middle-aged woman in casual clothing
shots.action: wincing and pressing both hands against her lower back while standing from a seated position
shots.setting: home office with natural window light, desk and chair visible
shots.narration: Over 80% of the global population suffers from chronic lower back pain, driven by intervertebral disc degeneration.

shots.subject: lumbar spine segment with vertebrae and intervertebral discs
shots.action: rotating slowly to reveal the layered anatomy of stacked vertebrae and gel-filled discs
shots.setting: dark studio background with rim lighting highlighting bone and soft tissue
shots.narration: The intervertebral disc sits between vertebrae, cushioning mechanical load.

shots.subject: single intervertebral disc in cross-section
shots.action: darkening and flattening as the central nucleus shrinks and the outer fibrous rings crack and separate
shots.setting: neutral gray background with directional lighting from upper left
shots.narration: Disc degeneration involves loss of hydration, structural collapse, and cellular death—but the mechanisms remain poorly understood.

shots.subject: gloved hands of a researcher
shots.action: pipetting a pink cell suspension into a tissue culture flask under a sterile hood
shots.setting: laboratory biosafety cabinet with bright white LED illumination
shots.narration: We isolated bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells and confirmed their identity and differentiation capacity.

shots.subject: spindle-shaped mesenchymal stem cells in monolayer
shots.action: elongating and spreading across the culture substrate as they proliferate
shots.setting: phase-contrast microscopy field with even Köhler illumination
shots.narration: These stem cells were encapsulated in an injectable chitosan hydrogel for delivery.

shots.subject: anesthetized rat positioned on a surgical platform
shots.action: receiving a fine needle insertion into the tail caudal disc under magnification
shots.setting: sterile surgical field with fiber-optic task lighting and sterile drapes
shots.narration: We created a needle-puncture model of disc degeneration in rats, then injected stem cells with or without hydrogel carrier.

shots.subject: annulus fibrosus cells in culture dish
shots.action: rounding up, detaching, and floating as membrane blisters form under oxidative stress
shots.setting: phase-contrast microscopy with time-lapse compression showing progressive damage
shots.narration: Oxidative stress induced by TBHP triggered ferroptosis—a distinct form of iron-dependent cell death characterized by lipid peroxidation.

shots.subject: annulus fibrosus cells co-cultured with mesenchymal stem cells
shots.action: maintaining elongated morphology and adherence despite oxidative challenge, remaining healthy and spread
shots.setting: phase-contrast microscopy field with even illumination, same time compression as res1
shots.narration: Co-culture with stem cells dramatically protected disc cells from ferroptotic death.

shots.subject: bar chart panels showing ferroptosis biomarkers
shots.narration: Stem cells reversed every hallmark of ferroptosis: they restored cell viability from 30% to 78%, reduced toxic iron accumulation, cut lipid peroxidation nearly in half, and replenished depleted glutathione—all with high statistical significance.

shots.subject: JAK2-STAT3 signaling pathway diagram
shots.narration: Mechanistically, stem cells suppressed the JAK2-STAT3 signaling pathway. When we reactivated STAT3 with an agonist, all protective effects vanished—confirming STAT3 inhibition as the critical mechanism.

shots.subject: bar charts of MRI signal intensity and histological degeneration grade
shots.narration: In vivo, the combination of stem cells and hydrogel significantly improved disc integrity by MRI and histology compared to either treatment alone.

shots.subject: rat intervertebral disc in sagittal MRI slice
shots.action: brightening and thickening as T2 signal intensity recovers, the nucleus re-expanding
shots.setting: grayscale MRI contrast with bone appearing dark and healthy disc bright
shots.narration: The hydrogel enhanced stem cell retention and therapeutic potency, reversing structural degeneration.

shots.subject: lumbar spine segment with restored intervertebral discs
shots.action: rotating to display uniform disc height and intact fibrous rings across all levels
shots.setting: soft studio lighting against dark background, highlighting healthy tissue contours
shots.narration: This work identifies ferroptosis as a new therapeutic target in disc degeneration and demonstrates that combining stem cells with biomaterial carriers can effectively suppress this pathway.

shots.subject: the same middle-aged woman from the opening shot
shots.action: standing upright and bending forward smoothly to pick up an object without discomfort
shots.setting: the same home office with natural window light, future-framed with hopeful tone
shots.narration: While clinical translation requires further validation, this combination strategy offers a mechanistic roadmap toward regenerative treatments that go beyond symptom management.
